## Why it matters

The NLS Data Foundry publishes open datasets from the National Library of Scotland, including digitised collections, catalogue metadata, and map and spatial data.

That makes it useful for historians who want to download, analyse, or reuse library data rather than only browse items through a standard catalogue interface.
